notes.title: Demo Update 0.0.1.0.0
notes.notes:
In this small update there is a complete re-work of the menu, the interface and the general user interface.

Furthermore, the controls and selection options in the settings now work as intended.


it is now possible to adjust the various volumes and to adjust the graphics options

notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.6.0
notes.notes:
FIX

- fixed some shader problems.
- fixed the Realtime shadows.
- fixed Legacy Diffuse Textures.
- fixed transparent UI problems.
- fixed fps problems(improved performance).
- fixed the "Spacewar" problem.
- fixed some "small" problems.


Added

- added craft system.
- added some meshes.
- added FX/SFX  effects.
- added details.
- added Zones.
- added Player names(but not input for custom names).
- added Anti-Aliasing.
- added Ambient occulsion.
- added Eye Adaption.
- added Motion Blur.
- added Bloom.
- added Color Grading.
- added Chromatic Abberation.
- added some custom post proccessing effects.
- added some textures.
- added Deferred Shading with linear lighting.
- added Critical error sender.
- added version number to the root folder.
- added steam_app_id to the root folder.
- added Reflection Probes.
- added and reworked Per-pixel lighting (normal maps, light cookies).
- added some "small" assets.


Reworked

- reworked the overall Interface/GUI.
- reworked/customized the overall graphic.
the game should look more beautiful now.
this is almost the final graphic-quality so far(means we are working on it).

- reworked some Light Culling Masks.
- reworked the number per pixels per texture of all textures.(HDR).
- reworked the damage and level system.
- reworked "small" assets.


next patch will be a bigger patch.
we are trying to focus on the gameplay now.
means we are fixing:
- the overall fighting system,
- level system, animations

working on some reworks:
- better graphics
- better UI


and will add ASAP:

- adding AI Soon,
- adding quests soon
- adding classes soon

after the update 0.0.0.7.0 we are waiting for reviews from our testers
to eventually fix something.

version 0.0.1.0.0 will be the last Alpha, the Open Alpha
means everyone who want to test Heir of darkness will get a key for it.

Heir of Darkness is well on schedule 
so it may be that the final early access version is already Online-Multiplayer.

have fun.

notes.title: Patch 0.0.0.5.2
notes.notes:
//FIXES

- Fixed an issue that caused you to be unable to move.

- Fixed an issue that resulted in data not being backed up / saved.

- movement has been improved a bit.

- Enemy animations have been improved a bit.

- performance has been slightly improved.

- Texture detail level increased

- Improved light performance

- Fixed an issue where the forge was already available to some players.

- The wall on the south side of the camp should now be in the correct position.


//ADDED

- Servers have been added.
   However, these are not yet available during alpha.

- Databases have been added.

- A quest has been added to test the databases.

- An Npc / quest giver has been added.

- more particles have been added.

//REMOVED

- The skill window was temporarily removed, which led to some players
   massive FPS drops.

- some scripts has been removed.

- some light sources have been removed.
